content.text: April 9, 2026, 5:03 a.m. PTThe Los Angeles Lakers visit the Golden State Warriors on Thursday, and if you're wondering how you can watch all the action live, you've come to the right place.After losing three games in a row, the hobbled Lakers are looking to salvage something as their regular-season schedule comes to a close. They have fallen 1.5 games behind the third-place Denver Nuggets and are tied with the fifth-place Houston Rockets with a 50-29 record. Los Angeles can still finish with the third seed in the Western Conference if it wins each of its remaining three games and Denver loses one of its remaining two games versus the Oklahoma City Thunder and San Antonio Spurs.The Warriors, like the Lakers, have multiple key players out due to injury. Stephen Curry missed two months with a knee ailment, and while he returned for their last two contests, he's listed as questionable for Thursday's matchup. Overall, the Warriors are 10th in the West with a 37-42 record, and they have lost 12 of their last 17 games.Los Angeles leads its season series against Curry and crew two games to one. This will be the fourth and final matchup this season between these two teams.Here's how to watch the Lakers game, including time, TV schedule and streaming information:What channel is Lakers vs Thunder game on today?
